purpose: Raw geodata sources for China Terrain Atlas boundary and river replacement work.

sources.name: geoBoundaries China ADM1 simplified GeoJSON
sources.use: Primary candidate for province boundary rendering.

sources.name: cn-atlas China prefecture boundaries GeoJSON
sources.use: Sharper prefecture-level administrative boundary rendering for close terrain inspection.

sources.name: Natural Earth Rivers and Lake Centerlines 1:10m
sources.use: Hydrology source for replacing hand-drawn river guides.

sources.name: Natural Earth Lakes 1:10m
sources.use: Lake and reservoir outline source for hidden water reference layer.

sources.name: Natural Earth Coastline 1:10m
sources.use: Coastline and island outline source for hidden water reference layer.

sources.name: China SRTM 90m full-density height grid
sources.license: SRTM / Open Topo Data dataset terms; verify before production redistribution
sources.use: Higher-density real DEM grid used as the runtime terrain mesh's preferred full-map national height source.

sources.name: China local DEM override tiles
sources.license: SRTM / Open Topo Data dataset terms; verify before production redistribution
sources.use: Local higher-density DEM replacement tiles for close-up terrain inspection and later tracing.

sources.name: China SRTM 90m medium-density height grid
sources.license: SRTM / Open Topo Data dataset terms; verify before production redistribution
sources.use: Medium-density real DEM grid used as the runtime terrain mesh's preferred national-scale height source.

sources.name: China SRTM 90m sample height grid
sources.license: SRTM / Open Topo Data dataset terms; verify before production redistribution
sources.use: Low-resolution real DEM sample used as the runtime fallback when the medium-density grid is unavailable.

sources.name: China local terrain detail patches
sources.use: Local meter-level offsets layered over the sample DEM to support later hand-sculpted or TopoExport-derived terrain detail patches.
